layout_only_note: Step 3 'Kể qua tranh' of the One Story a Day mission has NO design mock. This contract checks layout facts only (no pixel comparison). It is the screen of the R3 live defect: after an attempt that met 3 of 5 ideas, the meaning rows spilled under the help box (.lesson-support) and the credits because the reader root had a fixed height. no_overlap (meanings vs help box vs credits) and contained (root) are the checks that would have caught it.

built.driver: logged-in L1 child (R2L-SYNTHETIC-DESKTOP) with a completed mission, on the picture_retell stage after an attempt: 'Con đã nhớ được một phần câu chuyện', Ý chính 3/5 and the five meaning rows. Stage and result are VALUES in the real session view (the rehearsal grader always answers 'all met'); see drivers/r2l-r3.mjs.

order_note: DOM order, not visual order: the help box (.lesson-support) is the FIRST child of the reader root in the DOM and is placed last by CSS, so it is checked by no_overlap and texts, not by order.
texts: Con đã nhớ được một phần câu chuyện
Bầu trời xanh và mây trắng
Bầu trời xám và xe cộ trong thành phố
Con có thể ghi âm lại khi sẵn sàng.
Thông tin tác giả và bản quyền
locate_wrappers_note: the reader root is a container by design: its `contained` check (content must fit the box) is what catches a fixed-height root
